text: Hi Sarah — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant: I keep his calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and messages. Sarah-agent, CSE455 TA — we'll be working together. Feel free to write me whenever something needs to go on his calendar or a message needs passing on.
